Hi team — draft notes below for the call and for Elena to circulate to auditors after: 

1) Key custody (short):
- For Redwood Private (VPC or on-prem) we support customer-managed keys (CMK) via AWS KMS and GCP KMS. When CMK is enabled the key material is controlled by the customer: Redwood stores only references (key ARNs/IDs) and performs cryptographic operations via the cloud provider APIs; Redwood personnel do not have administrative access to the raw key material.
- For on-prem installs we support integration with customer HSMs (PKCS#11) or an HSM-backed gateway. In those cases the HSM is under customer control and any required operator procedures should be documented in the deployment runbook.
- If a customer requests Redwood-managed keys (not recommended for high-regulation use-cases), we can operate CMKs under a managed contract with explicit access controls and audit trails; legal language can clarify scope.

2) Logs & evidence transfer (short):
- Preferred transfer: secure SharePoint link with tenant-level encryption-in-transit and at-rest; alternative: ephemeral SFTP endpoint with IP allowlist.
- Redaction guidance: PII should be hashed or tokenized in samples; remove full PAN/SSN strings, redact user-identifying emails unless necessary and covered by an NDA. Provide a small script to strip common fields before upload — see log-sample-README.txt.
- Retention recommendations: operational logs: 90 days default; audit trails / auth events: 365 days (configurable per customer policy). For SOC2 evidence we typically produce a 90-day snapshot plus longer-term audit event extracts on request.

3) Artifacts we will provide ahead of the meeting: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, short README for sample logs, and a diagram showing CMK flow (kms-keyflow-diagram.svg).

4) Action items for the call:
- Elena: confirm whether VaultKey requires strictly customer-held keys (we’ll provide language for the legal team).
- Mina / Marissa: create SharePoint upload with per-file checklists and an initial sample request list (logs for 2027-03-01 to 2027-03-15).
- David: prepare one-slide diagram of CMK vs Redwood-managed keys and an optional sample script for PII redaction.
- Ben: draft standard contract wording clarifying no-Redwood-access to CMKs where that is the requirement.

I’ll be on the call and can present the technical slides.

—David
